t: A 10-inch Linux tablet with a detachable keyboard, made for tinkerers.
steps: Order the PineTab2 from the Pine64 store. It ships alone from Hong Kong.
Order a USB Wi-Fi dongle too. Pine64 suggests one for a stable connection.
Charge the tablet over the bottom USB-C port.
Attach the keyboard and boot the preinstalled DanctNix Arch Linux.
Plug in the Wi-Fi dongle and connect to your network.
Run a full system update from the terminal.
Read the Known Issues page in the Pine64 docs before you try suspend or the cameras.
Join the Pine64 forum to follow driver fixes.
